title: Charged twice
ticket: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription yesterday. Both charges have settled. Please help me get the duplicate payment back.

title: A late delivery
ticket: My parcel was due three days ago, but tracking has not moved since Monday. Can you check where it is? There is no deadline for delivery.

title: Orders are blocked
ticket: Every API request has returned a 500 error for the last 20 minutes. Our whole team cannot process customer orders and we have no workaround. Please investigate immediately.

title: A simple return
ticket: The jacket arrived today but it is too small. It is unworn with the tags attached. How do I start a return or exchange?

title: A general question
ticket: Hello! What are your customer support opening hours during the holiday period? I am just planning ahead. Thanks.

title: An unclear order issue
ticket: My order is wrong and the app looks strange. I see something pending and I am not sure whether that is a charge or a delivery status. Can someone help me figure this out?

title: A frustrated customer
ticket: This is my fourth message about returning the broken headphones. I am furious that nobody has sent a return label. If this keeps happening I am closing my account.

title: Ongoing payment harm
ticket: Several card payments I did not authorize are appearing right now. Another charge arrived while I was typing. Please help stop this ongoing loss immediately.
